scope: Exact finite CPU mechanism enumeration. Synthetic rows exercise current shared prepare_rows completion filter and fixed-sum complete-group denominator; no row is a real training sample and temporary rows are deleted. No heldout, GPU, optimizer, model sampling or reward relabeling.
gradient_sign_convention: Reported estimators are ascent directions sum(advantage * score)/action_mass; trainer PPO loss gradient is their negative. The fixed token scale is 1 for arithmetic; production 128 divides every compared gradient by 128 and preserves sign.
score_definition: Derivative of the log probability of the entire sampled response segment; repeated cutoff tokens represent its finite four-token cap, and their score sums to the stated segment score.
one_state_policy: Softmax logits with slopes [1,0,3] at probabilities [.1,.4,.5], so log-probability scores are [-.6,-1.6,1.4]. Terminal rewards [1,0,0] are all known from the finite MDP.
two_state_policy: At theta=0, complete-segment probability q_A=.5,q_B=.99 is independent of theta; conditional success logistic slopes k_A=24,k_B=-4, both conditional success probabilities .5. Cutoff failure probabilities .5/.01 are positive and scores are 0.
counterfactual_scope: In-memory replacement admits length solely to illustrate an explicitly defined capped-response-segment objective. It is not a production change or permission to mark unknown/truncated records trainable.
conclusion: Pre-action state/cohort selection removes reward-adaptive collection stopping but not natural-finish and verification censoring. Both the dropped segment and random complete-group mass can change the expected direction. Defining every fully observed capped response as a valid action removes the finish-reason censoring in these fully verified finite MDPs; it does not resolve unknown verification, off-policy continuation, clipping or numerical approximation.
arithmetic: All reported expectations are recomputed as exact rational sums over the saved complete case table; zero-numerator cases remain exact zero.
